parameters: Scale 0 3 5 7 10. Four lines of equal length. The second half repeats the first half a fifth lower
link_to_the_reference_composers: Bartók's base material. The lonely melody of Melody in the Mist is in this style

parameters: No fixed form or metre. Long held notes, fast ornaments, speech rhythm
link_to_the_reference_composers: Bartók found it in 1913. A model for free solo lines in slow movements

parameters: Groups of 2 and 3 at fast tempo: 2+2+3; 2+2+2+3; 3+2+2; 2+3
link_to_the_reference_composers: Bartók's "Bulgarian rhythm": String Quartet No. 5, Mikrokosmos

item: Flute melody heard from far away at night
parameters: Dorian mode. Narrow range. The melody grows out of repeated notes

item: Many callers who do not agree in time
parameters: About 4 o'clock at night. First one voice, then tens of voices. At one moment all hold one note: a major chord. Then silence, a cock, a dog, dawn
link_to_the_reference_composers: Corigliano heard it and wrote the Nocturne of the String Quartet and Symphony No. 2

parameters: Steps of about 150 cents (three-quarter tones). Free solo introduction (taqsim) with no metre
link_to_the_reference_composers: Bartók collected Arab music near Biskra in 1913. Corigliano uses quarter-tones for expression

item: Ragas for the hours of the night
parameters: Each raga has its hours. Yaman: start of night. Bageshri and Malkauns: middle of the night. Darbari Kanada: late night. Slow start with no metre (alap) above a drone
link_to_the_reference_composers: Same idea as night music: a slow, free line above a still background

item: Music for a full night in three stages
parameters: The mode (pathet) changes two times in the night: nem, sanga, manyura. Each stage is higher and more active. Gongs mark the time cycle
link_to_the_reference_composers: A model for a large form that follows the hours of the night

item: Cluster chords of the mouth organ (shō)
parameters: 11 standard chords of 5 or 6 notes, held with a slow change. Very slow tempo. Free time between strokes
link_to_the_reference_composers: Cluster harmony as a still background, much older than Bartók

parameters: One phrase = one breath. Silence (ma) is part of the music. Pitch bends, air noise
link_to_the_reference_composers: A model for a lonely melody with silence

item: Music for a ceremony that continues through the night
parameters: Cycles of 12 or 48 pulses. Two or more interlocked parts. The listener hears melodies that no single player plays
link_to_the_reference_composers: Layers that make new patterns together

parameters: 12 pulses: 2 2 1 2 2 2 1. All other parts align to the bell
link_to_the_reference_composers: A fixed cycle below free layers

parameters: Chords A minor, G, F, E. Cycle of 12 beats with accents on 3, 6, 8, 10, 12 (soleá)
link_to_the_reference_composers: Night as a subject in Spanish music (Falla)

item: Rocking song for a child at night
parameters: Small range. Falling minor third. Slow 6/8 or 2/4. Many repeats
link_to_the_reference_composers: Bartók: Lullaby from Village Scenes is on the night music list

parameters: Fire-bellied toad (Bombina bombina), cicada, birds; tufted titmouse, wood thrush
